types.Action: {type:'fold'}|{type:'check'}|{type:'call'}|{type:'bet',to:number}; bet carries the total for the street
types.Style: {tight:number,aggr:number,bluff:number}, each 0 to 1; which player has which style belongs to the caller
types.StrategyMemory: Record<playerId,{actions,aggressive,calls,folds,vpip,handsSeen}>, owned and stored by the caller

newMemory.returns: StrategyMemory (a fresh empty memory, plain JSON)

choose.returns: Action|null (decide for an observation; null when there is no observation, it is not this player's turn, or the value is not a DecisionInput; never changes memory)

decide.returns: Action|null (null when legal.fold is false, that is when it is not this player's turn; a bet is always inside legal.bet)

observe.returns: StrategyMemory (the same object, changed in place; moves that are not fold, check, call or bet, such as show, are ignored)

settings.difficulty: integer 1 to 3; 1 samples little and ignores opponent reads, 2 is the recipe's reference player, 3 samples more and plays steadier
settings.aggression: integer 0 to 100; used when a Style gives no aggr

notes: The computer-players form is newMemory(), choose(observation, playerId, rng, memory) and observe(memory, observation, playerId, move): `observation` is a DecisionInput (what holdem-rules' observation returns for that player) and a move is an Action. decide(input, rng, memory) is choose without the player id.
